Introduction

Kim Doyeon is a South Korean singer, dancer, actress, and model under Fantagio. She was a member of Weki Meki and the project girl group I.O.I.

In 2016, Kim Doyeon participated in Mnet's survival television show, Produce 101, representing her agency, Fantagio. She ranked 8th overall, qualifying to be a member of the final group I.O.I. She debuted as a member of the group on May 4, 2016, with the release of the mini album 'Chrysalis', and was active with them throughout the entire length of their activities. I.O.I released their last song, "DOWNPOUR", on January 18, 2017, and held a concert from January 20 to 22, before eventually disbanding on January 29, 2017.

After I.O.I. disbandment, Doyeon, along labelmate and fellow I.O.I. member Choi Yoojung, debuted as a member of Fantagio's girl group Weki Meki on August 8, 2017, with the mini album "WEME". The group eventually disbanded in August 2024, after seven years together.

Doyeon made her acting debut in February 2018 after getting cast in a drama titled "Short", in which she played a supporting role. In August 2023, it was announced that she was to make her big screen debut in the movie "18 youth", which was released in 2024. Later, in January 2025, Doyeon made her musical debut with the play 'Anna X', where she played the role of Anna.
